rationale: Independent reading: held EO 12513 (50 FR 18629) declares the Nicaragua emergency and imposes trade prohibitions; held EO 12707 (55 FR 9707, Mar. 13, 1990): 'I hereby revoke Executive Order No. 12513 and terminate the national emergency declared in that order', effective immediately. The NEA sec. 202 savings paragraph preserves only pending actions, prior acts and matured rights/penalties, keeping no prohibition operating. Refutation attempts: right instrument and wording verified; whole revocation; no own term. D6: history events are the four annual continuation Notices (1986-1989), all before the revocation and only continuing it; corpus search for 'Order No. 12513' finds only EO 12707 (other hits are FR page numbers in EO 10311/12593 indexes and a tariff code in EO 14257). No later amendment, revival or earlier end ignored. NO upheld.
